info.installInstructions:
🔹Refer to our [Discord](https://discord.gg/jkcbbNbNkC) for any issues with the update and any other change logs. 
⚠️ You will encounter warning messages several times during installing this revision. Click "Yes install to staging anyway" on all warnings that appear.
⚠️ Don't forget to install new revisions to a seperate profile, and remove old mods to prevent conflicts.
⚠️ For stability, delete all files in Steam\steamapps\common\Cyberpunk 2077\r6\cache with each update, verify game files, then deploy mods via Vortex
⚠️ In Vortex, go to Settings on the left and then open V2077 Settings. Ensure the option "Automatically convert old style 'archive' mods to REDmods on install" is turned OFF. And "Don't prompt when reaching the fallback installer" is turned ON.
⚠️ Our collections support Vortex only. The Nexus Mod App (NMA) is beta, use at your own risk. We do not support provided for NMA issues.
⚠️ Blank screen after 2.3 update? Disable all mods, launch game vanilla, accept the EULA, then re-enable your mods.

Have a good games! 🎮💜
